newsitem.title: USA: PHC Inc unit expands client base.
newsitem.headline: PHC Inc unit expands client base.

text.p: PHC Inc said on Wednesday its Harmony Healthcare division signed a contract making it the primary provider for behavioral healthcare services to an additional 64,000 clients.

The contract, signed with health maintenance organization FHP of Nevada, is in addition to Harmony's current provisions to gaming corporations in Las Vegas, including the Mirage, Treasure Island and MGM Grand.
PHC provides alcohol and drug treatment and psychiatric care.
